title: Modelling for a device: normalise less, read faster

videos.script:
The server's tables were designed for every client. {{server}} A phone has a few screens and one person. So its schema starts from a list: each screen, and the question it asks.

The course list asks for a count on every launch. {{count}} You can store that count on the course row, and read three rows instead of adding up thousands. The danger is the write that forgets to update it. You will ship that bug on purpose, and watch the screen show a wrong number with full confidence. {{triggers}} Then let the database keep it true.

Next, ids. {{ids}} A phone and a tablet, both offline, both add a session. With a counter, both call it seven. With a UUID, they cannot collide.

And last, the window. {{window}} A phone keeps the weeks its screens reach, and never deletes a row it has not sent.
